name: Dashboard Backend v2 - Customer Request Classifier

parameters.content:
DASHBOARD BACKEND v2

Flow: Dashboard Webhook -> Valid Token? -> Get Customer Requests -> Get Agent Directory -> Get Workflow Errors -> Calculate Metrics v2 -> Send Dashboard Data

Bago sa v2:
- Kinukuha na rin ang Agent Directory at Workflow Errors tables
- Week-over-week deltas (hindi kasama ang kasalukuyang linggo)
- Avg response time + time saved (ROI)
- allRequests (buong listahan para sa Requests page)
- agents (para sa Agents page)
- systemHealth (para sa System Health page)

Setup after import:
1. Select Airtable credential sa LAHAT ng 3 Airtable nodes
2. Get Customer Requests -> table: Customer Requests
   Get Agent Directory -> table: Agent Directory
   Get Workflow Errors -> table: Workflow Errors
3. Same token pa rin sa Valid Token? node
4. I-UNPUBLISH muna ang lumang v1 workflow (same webhook path), saka i-Publish ito
